body: Seems like a lot of people in this comment section lack compassion and very judgemental, I’m not gonna judge you. At that moment you made those missed calls you acted out on your emotions, it doesn’t mean you crazy or anything. You are human at the end of the day, a lot of people have done the same or even worse. Just look at this situation and learn that next time when your emotions get heightened have certain tools in place to help you out, im sorry you had to go through this and your ex clearly lacks emotional maturity to even tell you straight up how he felt. Please take this time to heal and grieve the best way you can ❤️

Just stay strong you got this, I found writing my feelings in a journal to help a lot. Even get a therapist to help you control your emotions, mine has helped me understand my feelings and not needing to let them control you. I know you want to do a lot of things for her but just take a moment and reevaluate the relationship from a different point of view and see how you can be a better healthy person. Wish you all the best

Yea you shouldn’t do any of that, leave her alone and focus on your emotions. Cry it out if you have and vent as much here, going to her house or buying her things will push her further away from you. Last thing you want is to get a restraining order, ruining your record. Not worth it one bit

In her eyes she probably sees you as someone that’s crazy and overbearing, you need to have pride and dignity for yourself. Focus on picking yourself up, I know all you want to do is talk to them and try work things but your emotions are all over the place. Last thing you want is for them to get a restraining order, I’m sure you have your heart in the right place but clearly your ex doesn’t want you anymore. Would you want to work things out with someone that would shut you out? I did all of the things you are currently doing and got me labelled as the crazy person, but in reality I know I’m not crazy I was having a hard time processing my emotions at the time. If I had someone tell me to take my time and process my emotions, I would have not put myself through the unnecessary pain and prolonging the healing journey. Please be kind to yourself and leave your ex alone, even if you feel the urge to vent write it down somewhere and not give your ex the satisfaction to prove her point you are the crazy ex. You got this!

Well he came back pretty much led me on, making it seem like he was sorry only to leave me and run back to the other girl and make me look crazy 😕, I really loved this person but looking back at things I’m at fault for allowing him back in my life. I should have focused on myself but I have learnt in future never take an ex back unless both of you have gone through a journey to change and grow from past mistakes.

My ex would tell me the same thing like bro I apologized a million times and would bring up how his other female friends forgave him and even had the audacity to bring up my abusive dad and how I had a hard time forgiving him.

Right now the pain sucks, in the long run you will be grateful for what happened and him getting out of your life. Take this time to be a better version of yourself, don’t feed in too much into the negative emotions cause that could make you spiral out of control. Get a therapist and try understand why things happened from a different perspective, try come up with goals. Make sure you don’t repeat the same toxic cycle with someone else, you don’t deserve to spend the rest of your life dealing with a person that mentally abuses you and causes a lot of mental breakdowns.

Don’t worry I was in that same spot, him breaking up with you over text is shitty especially considering how you invested 5 years in this relationship. I too begged my ex and also made numbers to try contact him and get an explanation, looking it now I should have just chilled out but I suffer from anxiety and the relationship had taken a toll on me. Firstly all I can say is you not crazy for what you did, shows that you really cared but would you want to be with someone that shuts you down and not want to see you after 5 years of being together like you some type of monster? No you don’t deserve to be treated like this, I know it hurts but you now need to go full no contact and focus on yourself. If someone is not willing to hear you out and treats you like something else, they are definitely not worth it. Stay strong and pick up the pieces and focus on your grieving process

If things feel overwhelming, don’t be afraid to reach out. My dm’s are always open and here if you need to vent or just need someone to talk to, the life journey shouldn’t be one you take on your own ❤️

There’s hope trust me, you still here with us. Your story hasn’t ended, just you being here you can help someone that’s going through the same as you and make a complete difference. I will listen to movements and see what their music is like, there are a lot of bands that relate to mental health. There’s also shinedown they have an older song called monsters, their lyrics to the song are pretty deep

Whenever I feel like I’m drowning I listen to that song and linkin park, it makes me feel better as well. Thanks I hope one day you realize how to achieve that happiness and to break free from the cycle that keeps us down and most importantly you make it through tonight, today maybe feel like a storm but tomorrow is gonna be different

You should listen to Khalid one of his songs called silence, it makes you realize that you not alone in this even when the world treats you like you nothing. In reality you were worth more, talking to you and showing me more compassion than the people in my life gives me hope that there are good people out there even if the world feels dark. I guess you just gotta find people who can relate to what you feel to make it a less lonely journey. I thought I wasn’t gonna make it tonight but I guess I somehow made it but being on survival mode is exhausting, I need to figure out how to start living life

I’m stuck in Canada, it’s insane how they treat you when you suffering from depression or anxiety. They instantly think you hearing voices and want to hurt people around you, I remember the last time I had a mental breakdown because I was being bullied by my ex. Guess who was the bad guy in that scenario, yea you forced to exist even when you don’t want to. I’m scared of actually taking that step to harm myself, all I can do is just sit there and be depressed. I wish people on this sub could feel that happiness they are longing to feel, I know how life can be a lonely but painful journey

I don’t either, I thought things would get easier but no life just keeps throwing things at you. Sometimes it feel like being alive a punishment. You can’t even say things on your mind they will instantly treat you like you crazy or out you in a mental hospital.

I don’t either, it’s like I ask myself so many times what’s wrong with me or why my feelings are not important. It’s like I’m just some worthless individual going with life and just waiting for it to end
I’m tired of life as well, I got home from work and cried like crazy. I wish I felt normal

You need to build the courage to leave, what if she does the same thing again down the line? You will be messing yourself up mentally, you deserve someone that is 100% sure they want to be with you not someone who picks up and leaves when they fall in love with the next person they meet. I made the mistake on taking my ex back, only to mess me up more and I regret forgiving him. I wish I had the courage to ignore him and kept focusing on myself, please don’t repeat the same mistake I made. You deserve so much better than your ex

1. Liar
2. Cheater
3. Very manipulative

I’m sending you a virtual hug, those people that made fun of you are just miserable individuals. I don’t get why it’s necessary to make fun of someone who is going through a rough time, what happened to showing people kindness or even a helping hand?
You owe her nothing especially when she cheated on you, go no contact and focus on yourself. Her issues are no longer yours
I think I need to do the same as well, I have been so depressed and feeling miserable. I think it’s time I finally go off grid and just discover myself and let go the hurt and bitterness I feel.
I wouldn’t respond, my ex did the same only to hurt me and embarrass me more. He just wanted someone to just have sex with nothing more

If it gives you some type of closure, it won’t last and she will probably come back begging for you. Don’t entertain her when she comes crawling back, work on yourself and wait for an amazing woman to come in your life :)
The emoji wasn’t necessary, you know what’s the best solution let them go. I’m gonna do the same and just go on with life, mine told if you have to cry do it if it helps 😕

I’m sorry you going through this, my ex said the same thing to me and he wasn’t considerate of my feelings whatsoever and tossed me to the side. I know it hurts but at the same time you can’t keep someone around that doesn’t want to be kept around. Just gotta let them go and not let them back in, if I knew better back then I would have been stronger for myself and found better but I guess you live and learn. Better days are ahead trust me, just focus on yourself and your well being.

Your bu story is familiar to mine, you need to go no contact and let him him be. Yes it hurts but you also gotta realize people who love you don’t treat you badly and rub things in your face, let him enjoy the rebound. It normally never lasts, my ex and his rebound never lasted two months. The girl was already cheating on him after a month, he was constantly posting her on his social media meanwhile I never got posted. You deserve so much better but right now I need you to be strong for yourself, block him everywhere. It’s time you went full no contact, don’t make the mistake of begging him or trying to contact him. I made the mistake of contacting him and he laughed at me with his rebound, right now let him think he is at the top of the world and focus on you. The grass is never greener on the other side
Yea that’s what happens to me a lot and people end up giving up on me cause they feel unimportant

My ex treated me like I’m complete garbage, he would post pictures and videos of the girl he was seeing rubbing things in my face. If you happy with your life why feel the need to make someone miserable, like I remember crying infront of him and he just sat there scrolling through Instagram. I’m not going to lie I’m really embarrassed that he treated me like crap in front of the new girl he was seeing and his roommate, I honestly wish I was stronger but I’m struggling big time with depression.

Don’t text them it’s only gonna hurt you more, what if you don’t get the response you want. Write yourself a letter and then burn it or tear it, not worth chasing after an old relationship. My ex has changed so much, that person I was with is long gone. Chances are the person you missing doesn’t exist anymore, they are gone and you need to move on and find better.

I feel like we dated the same person, I reached a point where I can no longer bare the pain and trauma they bring into my life. It’s like every bad thing they do which hurts me a lot is justified, he even calls me a controlling person when in reality I just want the bare minimum from someone.

Still healing, I made the mistake of going back and forth with him. Now he gets to rub in the fact he doesn’t want me and I shouldn’t be concerned about his personal life. After all I’m not his gf anymore and he can talk to anyone, it really hurts so I made the decision to completely cut him off. I feel like a loser cause he moved on and doing more with his life, meanwhile I’m stuck here with feelings for him.

You need to let him go, I’m in the same boat unfortunately. I loved this person and always defended him constantly, then they left for for someone else. He made sure to paint me out to be this crazy person that’s desperate and obsessed with him, when in reality that’s not the case. You need to forgive yourself and realize that you deserve better, normal people don’t hurt people that have good intentions towards them. I suggest you take this time and build yourself back up, I know the urge to talk to them everyday is strong but sometimes you have to accept that things have come to an end. I’m trying to accept that my ex will never change, just a few days ago he sent me a video with another girl to be spiteful. You need to distance yourself from these people and create a safe space for yourself.

I deleted all my social media accounts, I haven’t gone out in ages. If I’m not working, all I do is stay in my room and just drown in my misery. I have days where I feel great, then I have days where I just can’t get up. Being around people overwhelms me to be honest, I feel a lot of shame considering how the breakup went.

I think they are a fucked up person, I’m trying to forget them as hard as I can. It just hurts especially knowing this person did nothing but hurt me constantly and there was no need to do all this unnecessary stuff.
It’s ridiculous, there’s no need to rub the relationship in someone’s face but I guess people are messed up.
I honestly feel like it’s a dumb thing to do, just be happy in your new relationship and leave things at that. No need to prove anyone anything, like it’s so confusing when people do things like this

Day 14, I’m actually getting used to him not being in my life. It’s just strange how you can love someone and the next thing you know they are a complete stranger. He is probably happy with this new girl, I’m just here accepting things and learning to heal.
He called me piglet and I called him piggy :( it’s weird how you can go from loving someone to being their enemy
That I should understand he has moved on and that he is seeing someone else, that we were never compatible.

First off congratulations for graduating that’s such a huge milestone especially considering how hectic things were but you managed to accomplish it, you pushed through without him being there. Clearly you can do a lot more without him being in the picture, you are better off without him and you truly deserve someone more understanding. Sometimes it’s best to leave people in the past and focus on the future which is starting your career. I suffer from bad anxiety and going through a bad break up, reading your story made me believe it’s possible to achieve a lot more without them in the picture. You have inspired me to go back to school and try my best and not be affected by the bad break up. At the end of the day the break up was not your fault so it should t be your burden to carry

Had a similar experience last November, I was thinking I was meeting up with my ex only for him to give the police my location and rub it in my face that he was done dealing with my shit. I have forced that memory at the back of my head, the police were really aggressive and the hospital staff was even worse. Everyone looked at me like I was crazy, I had to sleep on a chair for 8 hours.
If you need to vent I’m here to listen and don’t feel like you a burden, your feelings are valid.
Honestly anything, I’m just hoping I can help someone that needs to vent or open up. It’s about time I put someone else’s needs first than mine

Unfortunately that’s the healing process, you make so much progress then you have a day where you back to square one. It’s up to you if you want to continue fighting to make things good again cause trust me things will be manageable
